scope: Probe speculative routing before a feature-preserving grid; defer unused routing to a fallback. Accepted photo routings can finish their 160-step polish within the existing deadline. No changed crop, colour classifier, source pixels, geometry or feature acceptance rules.

fallbackDiagnostic.runtimeVersion: 1991e27; the resumed-routing regression is also rerun in the final 4c6f1a7 suite
fallbackDiagnostic.method: Fresh hjfig-05 photograph pixels; advance performance.now by 1000 ms on the first graph progress event to expire only the initial short probe. No saved cutting paths or changed source mask.

limitations: Floating-point chord-based intersection checks, not exact algebraic predicates.
Samples on a target cut within twice the geometry tolerance have no unambiguous colour and are counted separately.
Forward image sampling supplements the edge-parity and path-topology checks; it is not an exact area comparison.
Cut-error simulation and paper-core analysis are separate from this nominal validator.
